topic: Testing lidar data capture and settings
summary_markdown:
The session focused on testing a large Lidar unit, initially set up in the office network. Initial issues included connection errors (UDP profile) and poor data quality, with frame rates below 10 FPS.

Improvements were made by adjusting parameters and cleaning the sensor. The output showed better detection of walls and objects, though some movement artifacts remained, suggesting potential reflections or environmental interference (e.g., ceiling).

The next steps involve testing the unit outdoors, replicating previous successful setups, as the current settings failed to stabilize it.

It was noted that while the image quality improved significantly, the system might not be capable of point-to-point targeting like a previous setup.
decisions: The Lidar unit will be tested outdoors next.
action_items: Adjusting parameters for the Lidar unit to improve stability and performance.
Testing the Lidar unit's capability for point-to-point targeting.
